Depth is partial and deliberately so. The four figures were available only as captions, and Figure 4 IS the survival analysis behind the mortality claim while Figure 3 is the variant map. Judging either from its caption is the failure the captions_only value exists to prevent.

Figure images could not be retrieved: the PMC OA package returns 404, the OA PDF path 404, direct /bin/ image URLs redirect without resolving, and the Europe PMC PDF endpoint returns 404. Only the JATS full text is available.
Two supplementary items are declared in the XML and were not retrieved.
Tables 1 and 3 were read; they are inline in the JATS and carry the cohort genotype-class distribution and the comparison against the published literature.
Verbatim locators were captured during the reading, per the deep-dive contract added 2026-08-04, and are recorded in the reading result.
This reading does NOT make CLAIM 017 exportable: the export gate requires complete_fulltext_read, and this is not one.
The paper independently corroborates CLAIM 030 from a source LEGEND had not read: p.Pro47Thr is reported in SCAR12 and p.Pro47Arg in WWOX-DEE, the same residue with different severity.
It also qualifies the clean spectrum picture: there is no regional predilection for missense variants causing WWOX-DEE versus SCAR12, and both phenotypes may arise from biallelic missense variants.
